name: t22-cap05
title: T22 · Cap. 5 · A evolução do perfil (narração 27,9 s; marcas L1..L4 = início de cada linha do roteiro)

setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{const f=document.querySelector('section[aria-label^="Lembrete da trilha"]');const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('div.fixed')].some(x=>getComputedStyle(x).backgroundColor==='rgb(17, 17, 17)');if((f||e)&&window.__avisos.length<10&&!window.__avisos.includes('TRILHA DOMIFLIX'))window.__avisos.push('TRILHA DOMIFLIX')},300);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Ao responder a nova avaliação", "Evolução do perfil", "Comparando com a avaliação anterior", "Sua Influência subiu", "Linha do tempo", "Ver desta data"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main")].filter(e=>!false||e.innerText.includes(""));const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('main');const el=[...m.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim()==="Evolu\u00e7\u00e3o do perfil");if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const sc=(()=>{for(let p=el.parentElement;p;p=p.parentElement){const s=getComputedStyle(p);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&p.scrollHeight>p.clientHeight+4)return p}return document.scrollingElement})();const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-200);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=sc.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1000),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;sc.scrollTo({top:y0+dy*e,behavior:'instant'});p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
steps.label: Evolução do perfil (cursor fora dos gráficos)

steps.js: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('main');const el=[...m.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.textContent.trim().startsWith("Comparando com a avalia\u00e7\u00e3o anterior:")).sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length)[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const sc=(()=>{for(let p=el.parentElement;p;p=p.parentElement){const s=getComputedStyle(p);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&p.scrollHeight>p.clientHeight+4)return p}return document.scrollingElement})();const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-300);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=sc.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1000),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;sc.scrollTo({top:y0+dy*e,behavior:'instant'});p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
